Reasoning: This release stage keeps the panda_fingertip end-effector pose fixed while commanding the gripper to open. freeze_position holds the current panda_fingertip origin position with the specified 0.01 m tolerance. freeze_orientation preserves the current panda_fingertip orientation, including its current tool +z and +y directions, without adding any alignment to estop_cap_center. open_gripper represents commanding both fingers toward the fully open/released state. The API does not expose individual finger joint targets, opposing finger-axis motion, gripper squeeze/contact effort, or explicit monitoring constraints, so those feedback/stop details are noted here but not separately encoded.
